summary: The exact candidate bounds agent bearer lifetimes to at most 365 days, substitutes a finite 7-day fallback for missing, zero, negative, NaN, or infinite values, writes both agent indexes with KV expirations, treats year-9999 and invalid legacy expiries as expired on lookup and exchange, and adds regression tests for all required lifetime inputs and legacy records.

evidence: src/auth_store.ts lines 1562-1588 map missing, zero, negative, NaN and infinite ttlMs to the finite 7-day default and clamp the result to authConfig.agentTokenMaxTtlMs, writing both index records with expireIn.
src/auth_store.ts lines 379-381 and 1601-1622 treat the year-9999 sentinel and invalid or elapsed expiries as expired, delete both indexes on lookup, and reject exchange, touch and label updates.
src/auth_config.ts lines 325-341 replace zero and negative ttlDays with a finite fallback and cap oversized requests at 365 days.

tests/bun_test.ts lines 437-542 and src/config_test.ts lines 237-267 cover missing, zero, negative, NaN, Infinity, oversized and year-9999 inputs, including no KV TTL and exchange rejection; docs/DECISIONS.md documents the migration policy.
